```{r}
  observed = as.integer(observed_per_sample),
  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)
observed_df <- observed_df %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = "observed",
    Value   = observed
  )

# 找出 alpha_df 中存在但 observed_df 中缺失的列
extra_columns <- setdiff(alpha_columns, observed_columns)
# 2. 从 alpha_df 中提取这些缺失的列并将其添加到 observed_df 中
for (col in extra_columns) {
  observed_df[[col]] <- alpha_df[[col]][match(observed_df$sample, alpha_df$sample)]
}

# 3) 生成单一 Measure 的图（不显示 p 值）
make_alpha_plot <- function(df, measure_label, ylab = "Alpha index value") {
  df_meas <- df %>%
    filter(Measure == measure_label, !is.na(Value)) %>%
    droplevels()
  
  ggplot(df_meas, aes(x = canon, y = Value)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(colour = canon),
      outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      aes(fill = canon),
      size = 1.1, shape = 21, stroke = 0, width = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      aes(colour = canon),
      size = 1.1, shape = 21, stroke = 0.25, width = 0.2, fill = NA
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_color, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_color1, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.length = unit(8, "pt"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
}
# 4) 分别生成 p1（shannon）与 p2（observed）
p1 <- make_alpha_plot(alpha_df, "shannon",  ylab = "Shannon")
p2 <- make_alpha_plot(alpha_df, "observed", ylab = "Observed")

pairwise_canon <- function(alpha_df, measures = c("shannon", "observed"),
                           method = "t.test", p_adjust = "BH", digits = 4) {
  alpha_df <- alpha_df %>%
    mutate(Measure = tolower(Measure),
           canon = droplevels(factor(canon)))

  out <- lapply(measures, function(m) {
    dfm <- alpha_df %>%
      filter(Measure == m, !is.na(Value), !is.na(canon)) %>%
      droplevels()

    grps <- levels(dfm$canon)
    if (length(grps) < 2) {
      message(sprintf("[跳过] %s 组数 < 2，无法比较。", m))
      return(NULL)
    }
    comps <- combn(grps, 2, simplify = FALSE)

    res <- ggpubr::compare_means(
      Value ~ canon, data = dfm,
      method = method, p.adjust.method = p_adjust,
      comparisons = comps
    ) %>%
      transmute(
        Measure = m,
        group1, group2,
        p, p_adj = p.adj,
        method,
        p_round = signif(p, digits),
        p_adj_round = signif(p_adj, digits)
      ) %>%
      arrange(p_adj, p)

    cat("\n==============================\n")
    cat(sprintf("Measure: %s | Method: %s | Adjust: %s\n", m, method, p_adjust))
    print(res %>% select(Measure, group1, group2, p_round, p_adj_round))

    res
  })

  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}

# 示例调用
res_tbl <- pairwise_canon(alpha_df, measures = c("shannon", "observed"))
res_sig <- res_tbl[res_tbl$p_adj < 0.05, ]

    p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p_adj < 0.01 ~ "**",
    p_adj < 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ))

#两两检验
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(pairwiseAdonis)  # 或 library(pairwiseAdonis2) 视你安装的为准
library(dplyr)

# 只保留 A1-A4, B1-B6, C1-C6 这 16 个组的样本
canon_keep <- c(paste0("A", 1:4), paste0("B", 1:6), paste0("C", 1:6))
physeq_sub <- subset_samples(physeq.spA1toC6, canon %in% canon_keep)

## 1) 计算 Bray-Curtis 距离
dist_bray <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_sub, method = "bray")
dist_jaccard <- phyloseq::distance(physeq_sub, method = "jaccard")
## 2) PERMANOVA 总体检验
sample_data_df <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_sub))

permanova_bray <- adonis2(
  dist_bray ~ canon,
  data        = sample_data_df,
  permutations = 999
)
permanova_bray  # 查看整体组间是否有差异

## 3) pairwise PERMANOVA (Bray)
pairwise_jaccard <- pairwise.adonis(
  x      = as.matrix(dist_jaccard),
  factors = sample_data_df$canon,
  perm   = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "BH"  # FDR 校正，也可以用 "bonferroni"
)

pairwise_bray
pairwise_jaccard

calc_cor_RMT_for_group <- function(abund_mat,
                                   rmt_interval = c(0.3, 0.8),
                                   nr_thresholds = 26,
                                   pseudo_count = 0.01) {
  # abund_mat: 行 = 物种，列 = 样本
  
  # 1) 转成行为样本、列为物种（cor 默认列为变量）
  comun <- t(abund_mat)
  
  # 2) 0 替换为小值，防止 log(0)
  comun[comun == 0] <- pseudo_count
  
  # 3) log 转换
  log_comun <- log(comun)
  
  # 4) 计算 Pearson 相关矩阵
  #    注意：这里相关的是“物种与物种”的关系
  occor.r <- cor(log_comun, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  occor.r <- as.matrix(occor.r)
  diag(occor.r) <- 0
  
  # 5) 使用 RMT 求阈值
  set.seed(111)
  rmt_res <- rm.get.threshold(
    occor.r,
    nr.thresholds = nr_thresholds,
    interval      = rmt_interval,
    discard.zeros = TRUE,
    unfold.method = "spline"
  )
  
  # RMT 推荐的阈值（你也可以改成固定值，如 thre <- 0.44）
  thre <- rmt_res$threshold
  
  list(
    cor_mat   = occor.r,
    rmt_res   = rmt_res,
    threshold = thre
  )
}

thres_vec <- vapply(
  RMT_results_list,
  function(x) as.numeric(x$rmt_res$chosen.thresholds)[1],
  FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
)

thres_df <- data.frame(
  group     = names(thres_vec),
  threshold = thres_vec,
  row.names = NULL
)

#从相关矩阵 + 阈值生成邻接矩阵
build_adj_from_cor <- function(cor_mat, threshold, keep_sign = TRUE) {
  adj <- cor_mat
  adj[abs(adj) < threshold] <- 0
  if (!keep_sign) adj <- abs(adj)
  diag(adj) <- 0
  adj
}

#构建 igraph 网络列表

library(igraph)

net_list <- mapply(
  FUN = function(res, thre) {
    cor_mat <- res$cor_mat
    adj     <- build_adj_from_cor(cor_mat, thre, keep_sign = TRUE)

    graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
      adj,
      mode     = "undirected",
      diag     = FALSE,
      weighted = TRUE
    )
  },
  res  = RMT_results_list,
  thre = thres_vec,
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

#计算节点网络指标
get_node_metrics <- function(g, group_name = NA) {
  data.frame(
    group    = group_name,
    node     = V(g)$name,
    degree   = degree(g),
    strength = strength(g, weights = E(g)$weight),   # strength 仍然用权重
    betweenness = betweenness(g, directed = FALSE, weights = NA),
    closeness   = closeness(g,  weights = NA),
    eigen_centrality = eigen_centrality(g, directed = FALSE)$vector,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

node_metrics_all <- do.call(
  rbind,
  mapply(
    get_node_metrics,
    g          = net_list,
    group_name = names(net_list),
    SIMPLIFY   = FALSE
  )
)


##整体网络结构对比
get_net_metrics <- function(g, group_name = NA) {
  comp  <- components(g)
  giant <- induced_subgraph(g, which(comp$membership == which.max(comp$csize)))

  # Louvain：不使用权重（只看有没有边）
  cl <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = NA)

  data.frame(
    group          = group_name,
    n_nodes        = gorder(g),
    n_edges        = gsize(g),
    density        = edge_density(g),
    avg_degree     = mean(degree(g)),
    avg_clustering = transitivity(g, type = "average"),
    # 用无权图计算平均路径长度，避免负权报错
    avg_path_len   = if (gorder(giant) > 1) mean_distance(giant, weights = NA) else NA,
    modularity_louvain = modularity(cl),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

net_metrics_all <- do.call(
  rbind,
  mapply(
    get_net_metrics,
    g          = net_list,
    group_name = names(net_list),
    SIMPLIFY   = FALSE
  )
)

get_condition <- function(gname) {
  if (gname %in% paste0("A", 1:4)) {
    return("baseline")
  } else if (gname %in% paste0("B", 1:5)) {
    return("antibiotics")
  } else if (gname %in% c("B6", paste0("C", 1:6))) {
    return("post")
  } else {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
}

export_edges_by_group <- function(g, group_name) {
  edf <- as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")
  colnames(edf) <- c("from", "to", "weight")
  edf$group <- group_name
  edf$sign  <- ifelse(edf$weight > 0, "positive",
                      ifelse(edf$weight < 0, "negative", "zero"))
  edf
}
```

```{r}
process_group <- function(prefix,
                          in_dir  = "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/qt/科研/课题/抗生素影响肠菌组装课题/fig/result1",
                          out_dir = "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/qt/科研/课题/抗生素影响肠菌组装课题/fig/result1/gephi") {
  # 1. 文件路径
  cor_file <- file.path(in_dir,  paste0("otu_g_", prefix, "_correlation.tsv"))
  p_file   <- file.path(in_dir,  paste0("otu_g_", prefix, "_pvalues.tsv"))
  
  # 2. 读入矩阵
  cor_mat <- read.table(
    cor_file,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    comment.char = ""
  )
  p_mat <- read.table(
    p_file,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    comment.char = ""
  )
  
  # 行列名对齐（以防万一）
  p_mat <- p_mat[rownames(cor_mat), colnames(cor_mat)]
  
  # 3. 展平成长表
  cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(cor_mat)))
  p_df   <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(p_mat)))
  names(cor_df) <- c("Source", "Target", "Weight")
  names(p_df)   <- c("Source", "Target", "p")
  
  all_df <- merge(cor_df, p_df, by = c("Source", "Target"))
  
  # 4. 筛选 p < 0.05，去掉对角线
  sig_df <- subset(all_df, p < 0.05 & Source != Target)
  
  # 5. 去掉反向重复（无向边）
  sig_df$S1 <- pmin(as.character(sig_df$Source), as.character(sig_df$Target))
  sig_df$S2 <- pmax(as.character(sig_df$Source), as.character(sig_df$Target))
  sig_uniq <- sig_df[!duplicated(sig_df[c("S1", "S2")]), ]
  
  # 6. 构建边表 A_spar（绝对值 > 0.2）
  A_spar <- sig_uniq[, c("S1", "S2", "Weight")]
  names(A_spar) <- c("Source", "Target", "Weight")
  A_spar$Type <- "Undirect"
  A_spar <- subset(A_spar, abs(Weight) > 0.2)
  
  # 7. 构建点表 A_node
  all_ids <- unique(c(A_spar$Source, A_spar$Target))
  labels <- all_ids
  labels <- sub("^g__", "", labels)        # 去掉 g__ 前缀
  labels[grepl("GGB", all_ids)] <- "Unknown"
  
  A_node <- data.frame(
    ID    = all_ids,
    Label = labels,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # 8. 写出 CSV
  node_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "node.csv"))
  spar_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "spar.csv"))
  
  write.csv(A_node, file = node_file, row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(A_spar, file = spar_file, row.names = FALSE)
  
  # 返回 list（在函数内保持不变）
  invisible(list(node = A_node, spar = A_spar))
}
```

```{r}
gephi_dir <- "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/qt/科研/课题/抗生素影响肠菌组装课题/fig/result1/gephi"
# 1.建议先设好分组顺序（时间序列）

library(dplyr)

node_files <- c("A2node.csv", "A3node.csv", "A4node.csv",
                "B1node.csv", "B2node.csv", "B3node.csv", "B4node.csv", "B5node.csv", "B6node.csv",
                "C1node.csv", "C2node.csv", "C3node.csv", "C4node.csv", "C5node.csv", "C6node.csv")

  if (!file.exists(full_path)) {
    warning("File not found: ", full_path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- read_csv(full_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  group <- str_extract(f, "^[ABC][0-9]+")  # 例如 "A2"

    phase = case_when(
      group %in% paste0("A", 1:4)      ~ "Baseline",
      group %in% paste0("B", 1:6)      ~ "Antibiotic",
      group %in% paste0("C", 1:6)      ~ "Recovery",

    )
  )

  full_path <- file.path(gephi_dir, f)
  if (!file.exists(full_path)) {
    warning("File not found: ", full_path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- read_csv(full_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  group <- str_extract(f, "^[ABC][0-9]+")
  n_edges <- nrow(df)
  n_pos   <- sum(df$Weight > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_neg   <- sum(df$Weight < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_abs_weight <- mean(abs(df$Weight), na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(
    group = group,
    n_edges = n_edges,
    n_pos = n_pos,
    n_neg = n_neg,
    pos_ratio = n_pos / n_edges,
    mean_abs_weight = mean_abs_weight
  )
}) |> bind_rows() |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_order),
    phase = case_when(
      group %in% paste0("A", 2:4) ~ "Baseline",
      group %in% paste0("B", 1:6) ~ "Antibiotic",
      group %in% paste0("C", 1:6) ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# 定义一个处理函数来生成节点和边的数据框
process_group <- function(cor_df, p_df) {
  # 把矩阵打平成长数据框
  cor_df_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(cor_df)))
  p_df_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(p_df)))
  
  # 改名便于理解
  names(cor_df_long) <- c("Source", "Target", "Weight")
  names(p_df_long) <- c("Source", "Target", "p")
  
  # 合并相关性和 p 值
  all_df <- merge(cor_df_long, p_df_long, by = c("Source", "Target"))
  
  # 筛选 p < 0.05，且去掉对角线（Source != Target）
  sig_df <- subset(all_df, p < 0.05 & Source != Target)
  
  # 生成“无向边”的标准表示
  sig_df$S1 <- pmin(as.character(sig_df$Source), as.character(sig_df$Target))
  sig_df$S2 <- pmax(as.character(sig_df$Source), as.character(sig_df$Target))
  
  # 按无向对去重
  sig_uniq <- sig_df[!duplicated(sig_df[c("S1", "S2")]), ]
  spar <- sig_uniq[, c("S1", "S2", "Weight")]
  names(spar) <- c("Source", "Target", "Weight")
  
  spar$Type <- "Undirected"
  spar <- subset(spar, abs(Weight) > 0.2)
  
  all_ids <- unique(c(spar$Source, spar$Target))
  
  # 初始 Label
  labels <- all_ids
  labels <- sub("^g__", "", labels)  # 去掉前缀 "g__"
  labels[grepl("GGB", all_ids)] <- "Unknown"  # 将包含 "GGB" 的物种标记为 "Unknown"
  
  # 构建节点数据框
  node <- data.frame(
    ID = all_ids,
    Label = labels,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  return(list(node = node, spar = spar))
}

# 处理P1组

P1spar <- P1_results$spar
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

gephi_dir <- "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/qt/科研/课题/抗生素影响肠菌组装课题/fig/result1/gephi"

group_order <- c(paste0("A", 2:4),
                 paste0("B", 1:6),
                 paste0("C", 1:6))

# 对应好每个组的 spar 文件和 degree 文件（按你实际有的改）
spar_files_by_group <- c(
  A2 = "A2spar.csv",
  A3 = "A3spar.csv",
  A4 = "A4spar.csv",
  B1 = "B1spar.csv",
  B2 = "B2spar.csv",
  B3 = "B3spar.csv",
  B4 = "B4spar.csv",
  B5 = "B5spar.csv",
  B6 = "B6spar.csv",
  C1 = "C1spar.csv",
  C2 = "C2spar.csv",
  C3 = "C3spar.csv",
  C4 = "C4spar.csv",
  C5 = "C5spar.csv",
  C6 = "C6spar.csv"
)

degree_files_by_group <- c(
  A2 = "degree_A2_bol.csv",
  A3 = "degree_A3_bol.csv",
  A4 = "degree_A4_bol.csv",
  B1 = "degree_B1_bol.csv",
  B2 = "degree_B2_bol.csv",
  B3 = "degree_B3_bol.csv",
  B4 = "degree_B4_bol.csv",
  B5 = "degree_B5_bol.csv",
  B6 = "degree_B6_bol.csv",
  C1 = "degree_C1_bol.csv",
  C2 = "degree_C2_bol.csv",
  C3 = "degree_C3_bol.csv",
  C4 = "degree_C4_bol.csv",
  C5 = "degree_C5_bol.csv",
  C6 = "degree_C6_bol.csv"
)

intra_module_stats <- purrr::map2_dfr(
  names(spar_files_by_group),
  spar_files_by_group,
  function(group, spar_fname) {

    spar_file   <- file.path(gephi_dir, spar_fname)
    degree_file <- file.path(gephi_dir, degree_files_by_group[[group]])

    if (!file.exists(spar_file) || !file.exists(degree_file)) {
      warning("Missing file for group ", group)
      return(NULL)
    }

    # 1) 边表：Source, Target, Weight
    edges <- read_csv(spar_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

    # 2) degree 表：Id, modularity_class 等
    deg <- read_csv(degree_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

    # 确认列名是否存在（防止拼写问题）
    if (!("Id" %in% names(deg))) {
      stop("列 'Id' 在文件中不存在：", degree_file)
    }
    if (!("modularity_class" %in% names(deg))) {
      stop("列 'modularity_class' 在文件中不存在：", degree_file)
    }

    # 3) 分别构建 Source 和 Target 的模块信息
    source_module <- deg %>%
      select(Source = Id, mod_source = modularity_class)

    target_module <- deg %>%
      select(Target = Id, mod_target = modularity_class)

    # 4) 把模块信息映射到边
    edges2 <- edges %>%
      left_join(source_module, by = "Source") %>%
      left_join(target_module, by = "Target")

    # 5) 标记模块内/模块间
    edges2 <- edges2 %>%
      mutate(
        edge_type = dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(mod_source) | is.na(mod_target) ~ "unknown",
          mod_source == mod_target             ~ "intra",
          TRUE                                 ~ "inter"
        )
      )

    intra_edges <- edges2 %>% filter(edge_type == "intra")
    inter_edges <- edges2 %>% filter(edge_type == "inter")

    tibble(
      group            = group,
      n_intra_edges    = nrow(intra_edges),
      mean_abs_intra   = mean(abs(intra_edges$Weight), na.rm = TRUE),
      pos_ratio_intra  = mean(intra_edges$Weight > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_inter_edges    = nrow(inter_edges),
      mean_abs_inter   = mean(abs(inter_edges$Weight), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
)

intra_module_stats <- intra_module_stats %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_order),
    phase = case_when(
      group %in% paste0("A", 2:4) ~ "Baseline",
      group %in% paste0("B", 1:6) ~ "Antibiotic",
      group %in% paste0("C", 1:6) ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

intra_module_stats <- intra_module_stats %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_order),
    phase = case_when(
      group %in% paste0("A", 2:4) ~ "Baseline",
      group %in% paste0("B", 1:6) ~ "Antibiotic",
      group %in% paste0("C", 1:6) ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

##追加一个“模块内-模块间差值”的指标

  )

# 画 diff 的柱状图

       fill = "Phase") +
```

##孤立模块化（modularization）现象分析2
```{r}
## ===============================
## 0. 基本设置与文件路径
## ===============================

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# 修改为你自己的路径
gephi_dir <- "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/qt/科研/课题/抗生素影响肠菌组装课题/fig/result1/gephi"

group_order <- c(paste0("A", 2:4),
                 paste0("B", 1:6),
                 paste0("C", 1:6))

# 每组 spar 文件
spar_files_by_group <- c(
  A2 = "A2spar.csv", A3 = "A3spar.csv", A4 = "A4spar.csv",
  B1 = "B1spar.csv", B2 = "B2spar.csv", B3 = "B3spar.csv",
  B4 = "B4spar.csv", B5 = "B5spar.csv", B6 = "B6spar.csv",
  C1 = "C1spar.csv", C2 = "C2spar.csv", C3 = "C3spar.csv",
  C4 = "C4spar.csv", C5 = "C5spar.csv", C6 = "C6spar.csv"
)

# 每组 degree 文件
degree_files_by_group <- c(
  A2 = "degree_A2_bol.csv", A3 = "degree_A3_bol.csv", A4 = "degree_A4_bol.csv",
  B1 = "degree_B1_bol.csv", B2 = "degree_B2_bol.csv", B3 = "degree_B3_bol.csv",
  B4 = "degree_B4_bol.csv", B5 = "degree_B5_bol.csv", B6 = "degree_B6_bol.csv",
  C1 = "degree_C1_bol.csv", C2 = "degree_C2_bol.csv", C3 = "degree_C3_bol.csv",
  C4 = "degree_C4_bol.csv", C5 = "degree_C5_bol.csv", C6 = "degree_C6_bol.csv"
)


## ===============================
## 1. 逐组构建 edges2（含 mod_source, mod_target）
## ===============================

make_edges2 <- function(group, spar_fname) {
  spar_file   <- file.path(gephi_dir, spar_fname)
  degree_file <- file.path(gephi_dir, degree_files_by_group[[group]])

  if (!file.exists(spar_file) || !file.exists(degree_file)) {
    warning("Missing file for group ", group)
    return(NULL)
  }

  edges <- read_csv(spar_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  deg   <- read_csv(degree_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # 简单检查列
  if (!("Id" %in% names(deg))) {
    stop("列 'Id' 在文件中不存在：", degree_file)
  }
  if (!("modularity_class" %in% names(deg))) {
    stop("列 'modularity_class' 在文件中不存在：", degree_file)
  }

  source_module <- deg %>%
    select(Source = Id, mod_source = modularity_class)
  target_module <- deg %>%
    select(Target = Id, mod_target = modularity_class)

  edges2 <- edges %>%
    left_join(source_module, by = "Source") %>%
    left_join(target_module, by = "Target") %>%
    mutate(group = group)

  edges2
}

edges2_all <- map2_dfr(
  names(spar_files_by_group),
  spar_files_by_group,
  make_edges2
)


## ===============================
## 2. 每组整体的模块内/模块间强度
## ===============================

intra_module_stats <- edges2_all %>%
  mutate(
    edge_type = case_when(
      is.na(mod_source) | is.na(mod_target) ~ "unknown",
      mod_source == mod_target             ~ "intra",
      TRUE                                 ~ "inter"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_intra_edges   = sum(edge_type == "intra"),
    n_inter_edges   = sum(edge_type == "inter"),
    mean_abs_intra  = mean(abs(Weight[edge_type == "intra"]), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_inter  = mean(abs(Weight[edge_type == "inter"]), na.rm = TRUE),
    pos_ratio_intra = mean(Weight[edge_type == "intra"] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_order),
    phase = case_when(
      group %in% paste0("A", 2:4) ~ "Baseline",
      group %in% paste0("B", 1:6) ~ "Antibiotic",
      group %in% paste0("C", 1:6) ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    diff_intra_inter = mean_abs_intra - mean_abs_inter,
    intra_ratio      = n_intra_edges / (n_intra_edges + n_inter_edges)
  )

## —— 图：mean_abs_intra - mean_abs_inter
ggplot(intra_module_stats,
       aes(x = group, y = diff_intra_inter, fill = phase)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Group",
       y = "Mean |SparCC| (intra - inter)",
       fill = "Phase") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

## —— 图：模块内边比例 intra_ratio
ggplot(intra_module_stats,
       aes(x = group, y = intra_ratio, fill = phase)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Group",
       y = "Proportion of intra‑module edges",
       fill = "Phase") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


## ===============================
## 3. 以“模块”为单位的内部平均相关性 & 对外开放度
## ===============================

# 仅保留有模块信息的边
edges2_clean <- edges2_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(mod_source), !is.na(mod_target))

# 3.1 每个模块内部平均相关性（只用模块内边）
module_level_stats <- edges2_clean %>%
  filter(mod_source == mod_target) %>%
  group_by(group, module = mod_source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_edges       = n(),
    mean_abs_spar = mean(abs(Weight), na.rm = TRUE),
    pos_ratio     = mean(Weight > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_order),
    phase = case_when(
      group %in% paste0("A", 2:4) ~ "Baseline",
      group %in% paste0("B", 1:6) ~ "Antibiotic",
      group %in% paste0("C", 1:6) ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# 汇总到组层面（模块层面的平均）
group_level_from_module <- module_level_stats %>%
  group_by(group, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abs_intra_module   = mean(mean_abs_spar, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abs_intra_module = median(mean_abs_spar, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## —— 图：模块为单位的内部平均相关性
ggplot(group_level_from_module,
       aes(x = group, y = mean_abs_intra_module, fill = phase)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Group",
       y = "Mean of module‑wise |SparCC|",
       fill = "phase") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


# 3.2 每个模块的“对外开放度” (外部边比例)

module_connectivity <- edges2_clean %>%
  mutate(same_mod = (mod_source == mod_target)) %>%
  group_by(group, module = mod_source) %>%
  summarise(
    Ein   = sum(same_mod),
    Eout  = sum(!same_mod),
    openness = Eout / (Ein + Eout),   # 对外开放度
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = group_order),
    phase = case_when(
      group %in% paste0("A", 2:4) ~ "Baseline",
      group %in% paste0("B", 1:6) ~ "Antibiotic",
      group %in% paste0("C", 1:6) ~ "Recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# 组层面平均开放度
group_openness <- module_connectivity %>%
  group_by(group, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_openness   = mean(openness, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_openness = median(openness, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## —— 图：模块对外开放度（越低越“孤立”）
ggplot(group_openness,
       aes(x = group, y = mean_openness, fill = phase)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Group",
       y = "Mean module openness (Eout / (Ein + Eout))",
       fill = "Phase") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```



##B6-C6趋势分析预处理
```{r}
# 提取所需的 OTU 数据框
group_names <- c("B6", paste0("C", 1:6))
OTU_list <- lapply(group_names, function(name) OTU_groups[[paste0("OTU_", name)]])

# 初始化一个空的数据框，用于存储结果
OTU_B6toC6 <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(OTU_list[[1]]))

# 遍历每个数据框，计算物种的平均相对丰度
for (i in seq_along(OTU_list)) {
  # 获取当前数据框
  current_OTU <- OTU_list[[i]]
  
  # 计算平均相对丰度
  mean_abundance <- rowMeans(current_OTU, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # 将结果添加到新的数据框中
  OTU_B6toC6 <- cbind(OTU_B6toC6, mean_abundance)
}

# 设置列名
colnames(OTU_B6toC6) <- group_names
```

```{r}
  A_samples <- current_data %>% filter(canon %in% c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4"))
  B6_samples <- current_data %>% filter(canon == "B6")
  C_samples <- current_data %>% filter(canon %in% c("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6"))
  
  # 创建 chazhi 数据框
  chazhi <- data.frame(
    row.names = c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4"),
    B6 = rep(NA, 4),
    C1 = rep(NA, 4),
    C2 = rep(NA, 4),
    C3 = rep(NA, 4),
    C4 = rep(NA, 4),
    C5 = rep(NA, 4),
    C6 = rep(NA, 4)
  )
  
  # 填充 chazhi 数据框
  for (A in row.names(chazhi)) {
    A_value <- A_samples %>% filter(canon == A) %>% pull(Value)
    if (length(A_value) > 0) {
      A_value <- A_value[1]  # 假设每个组只有一个值
      for (C in colnames(chazhi)) {
        if (C == "B6") {
          C_value <- B6_samples %>% filter(canon == C) %>% pull(Value)

        }
        if (length(C_value) > 0) {
          C_value <- C_value[1]  # 假设每个组只有一个值
          chazhi[A, C] <- C_value - A_value
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # 保存结果
  chazhi_result_list[[subject]] <- chazhi
}
```

```{r}
shannon_wide <- shannon_df %>%
  select(subject, canon, Value) %>%  # 选择相关列
  pivot_wider(names_from = canon,     # 将 canon 列作为列名
              values_from = Value)     # 将 Value 列作为值 

  ordered_colnames <- c("subject", "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", 
                       "B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", 
                       "C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6")
  shannon_wide <- shannon_wide %>%
  select(all_of(ordered_colnames)) 
  spearman_cor <- cor(shannon_wide[, -1], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")


Heatmap(spearman_cor, 
        name = "Spearman Correlation",  # 图例名称
        row_order = order(match(rownames(spearman_cor), rownames(spearman_cor))),  # 行的顺序
```

##C4到C6-A1到A4 差值定义恢复好/坏
```{r}
# 初始化一个空列表来存储每个subject的差值数据框
shannon_select_list <- list()

# 遍历每个subject
for (i in unique(shannon_df$subject)) {
  # 提取当前subject的数据
  subject_data <- shannon_df[shannon_df$subject == i, ]
  
  # 初始化一个空矩阵来存储差值
  diff_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = 3, ncol = 4, 
                        dimnames = list(c("C4", "C5", "C6"), c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4")))
  
  # 遍历每个A值和C值的组合
  for (a in c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4")) {
    for (c in c("C4", "C5", "C6")) {
      # 提取对应的A值和C值
      a_value <- subject_data[subject_data$canon == a, "Value"]
      c_value <- subject_data[subject_data$canon == c, "Value"]
      
      # 计算差值
      diff_value <- c_value - a_value
      
      # 将差值存储到对应的位置
      diff_matrix[c, a] <- diff_value
    }
  }
  
  # 将当前subject的差值矩阵存储到列表中
  shannon_select_list[[as.character(i)]] <- diff_matrix
}

# 计算每个subject的平均差值
subject_select_means <- sapply(shannon_select_list, function(matrix) mean(as.vector(matrix), na.rm = TRUE))

# 创建数据框
subject_select_means <- data.frame(
  subject = names(subject_select_means),  # 将 subject 名称作为列
  mean_value = subject_select_means,       # 将均值放入 mean_value 列
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE  # 避免将 subject 列转换为因子
)

# 对数据框按 mean_value 排序
subject_select_means <- subject_select_means %>%
  arrange(mean_value)

# 转换 subject 列为因子，以确保图表的顺序
subject_select_means$subject <- factor(subject_select_means$subject, levels = subject_select_means$subject)
# 绘图
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(subject_select_means, aes(x = subject, y = mean_value, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +  # 添加折线
  geom_point() +  # 添加点
  theme_minimal() +  # 使用简洁主题
  labs(title = "Average Shannon Difference by Subject",
       x = "Subject",
       y = "Average Shannon Difference") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

subject_select_means <- subject_select_means %>%
```

```{r}
# 定义函数来分析 beta 多样性
analyze_beta_diversity <- function(dataset, otu_table, metas) {
  # 定义 canon 组
  canon_groups <- c(paste0("A", 1:4), paste0("B", 1:6), paste0("C", 1:6))
  
  # 创建一个空的数据框来存储结果
  results <- list()
  
  # 遍历每个 canon 组
  for (canon in canon_groups) {
    # 过滤样本数据
    sample_data <- metas %>%
      filter((Quartile == 1 | Quartile == 4) & canon == !!canon) %>%
      mutate(Quartile = recode(Quartile, `1` = "P1", `4` = "P4"))
    
    # 打印过滤后的样本数量
    message(paste("对 canon:", canon, "的样本数量:", nrow(sample_data)))
    
    # 检查是否有可用的样本
    if (nrow(sample_data) == 0) {
      message(paste("没有找到符合条件的样本:", canon))
      next
    }
    
    # 从 otu_table 中筛选仅在 sample_data 行名中出现的样本
    otu_table_filtered <- otu_table %>%
      select(all_of(rownames(sample_data)))
    
    # 打印过滤后的 OTU 表
    message(paste("OTU 表的列数:", ncol(otu_table_filtered)))
    
    # 克隆数据集
    mt <- clone(dataset)
    mt$otu_table <- as.data.frame(otu_table_filtered)
    mt$sample_table <- sample_data
    
    # 处理数据集
    mt$tidy_dataset()
    mt$cal_betadiv()
    
    # 进行主坐标分析
    t <- trans_beta$new(dataset = mt, group = "Quartile", measure = "bray")
    t$cal_ordination(method = "PCoA", taxa_level = "s")
    t$Quartile <- as.factor(t$Quartile)
    
    # 进行 MANOVA 检验
    t$cal_manova(manova_all = FALSE, permutations = 999)

    # 存储结果
    results[[canon]] <- t$res_manova
    message(paste("分析完成:", canon))
  }
  
  return(results)
}

# 使用示例
# 假设 ABX_dataset 和 otu_table 是已有的数据集
beta_results <- analyze_beta_diversity(ABX_dataset, otu_table, metas)

# 查看结果
beta_results
```

```{r}
# 定义分析 beta 多样性及其差异的函数
analyze_beta_diversity_by_canon <- function(original_dataset) {
  # 定义目标 canon 组
  canon_groups <- c(paste0("A", 1:4), paste0("B", 1:6), paste0("C", 1:3))
  
  # 创建一个列表来存储所有组的 MANOVA 结果
  results <- list()

  # 遍历每个 canon 组
  for (canon in canon_groups) {
    # 定义数据集后缀
    dataset_suffix <- paste0("MT", canon)  
    MTA <- clone(original_dataset)    # 克隆原始数据集
    
    # 使用 dplyr 的 filter 来过滤样本数据
    MTA$sample_table <- MTA$sample_table %>% 
      filter(canon == !!canon)  # 使用 !! 来强制求值
    
    # 检查样本是否可用
    if (nrow(MTA$sample_table) == 0) {
      message(paste("没有找到符合条件的样本:", canon))
      next
    }
    
    # 预处理数据
    MTA$tidy_dataset()
    
    # 计算 β 多样性
    MTA$cal_betadiv()

    # 进行主坐标分析 (PCoA)
    beta_analysis <- trans_beta$new(dataset = MTA, group = "Quartile", measure = "bray")
    beta_analysis$cal_ordination(method = "PCoA", taxa_level = "s")
    
    # 将 Quartile 转换为因子
    beta_analysis$Quartile <- as.factor(beta_analysis$Quartile)
    
    # 进行 MANOVA 检验比较 P1 和 P4 的差异
    beta_analysis$cal_manova(manova_all = FALSE, permutations = 999)
    
    # 存储每个 canon 的 MANOVA 结果
    results[[dataset_suffix]] <- beta_analysis$res_manova
    
    # 打印当前 canon 分析完成的消息
    message(paste("分析完成:", canon))
  }
  
  # 返回所有组的 MANOVA 结果
  return(results)
}

# 使用示例
# dataset 是您原始的 microeco 数据集
# 假设 MT 已经在 R 环境中
result_manova_all <- analyze_beta_diversity_by_canon(MT)

# 查看结果
result_manova_all
```

```{r}
#比较P1和P4相对于A1的距离
parse_id <- function(ids) {
  last_uscore_pos <- function(x) {
    m <- gregexpr("_", x, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(m) == 1 && m[1] == -1) return(NA_integer_)
    max(m)
  }
  pos <- vapply(ids, last_uscore_pos, integer(1))
  if (any(is.na(pos))) {
    bad <- ids[is.na(pos)]
    stop("部分ID缺少下划线分隔，示例: ", paste(utils::head(bad), collapse = ", "))
  }
  data.frame(
    id = ids,
    subject = substr(ids, 1, pos - 1),
    canon   = substr(ids, pos + 1, nchar(ids)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
library(dplyr)

extract_dist_long <- function(dist_mat, meta_df, group_value = c("P1","P4")) {
  group_value <- match.arg(group_value)
  
  subj_in_group <- meta_df %>%
    filter(Quartile == group_value) %>%
    pull(subject) %>%
    unique()
  
  rn <- rownames(dist_mat)
  cn <- colnames(dist_mat)
  rinfo <- parse_id(rn)
  cinfo <- parse_id(cn)
  
  # 行：该分组 subject 的 A1
  row_keep <- rinfo$subject %in% subj_in_group & rinfo$canon == "A1"
  # 列：该分组 subject 的非 A1
  col_keep <- cinfo$subject %in% subj_in_group & cinfo$canon != "A1"
  
  sub_mat <- dist_mat[row_keep, col_keep, drop = FALSE]
  rinfo_sub <- rinfo[row_keep, ]
  cinfo_sub <- cinfo[col_keep, ]
  
  if (nrow(sub_mat) == 0 || ncol(sub_mat) == 0) {
    return(dplyr::tibble(
      group = character(0),
      row_id = character(0), row_subject = character(0), row_canon = character(0),
      col_id = character(0), col_subject = character(0), col_canon = character(0),
      distance = numeric(0)
    ))
  }
  
  df_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(sub_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df_long) <- c("row_id", "col_id", "distance")
  
  df_long <- df_long %>%
    left_join(rinfo_sub %>% select(id, row_subject = subject, row_canon = canon),
              by = c("row_id" = "id")) %>%
    left_join(cinfo_sub %>% select(id, col_subject = subject, col_canon = canon),
              by = c("col_id" = "id")) %>%
    mutate(group = group_value) %>%
    select(group, row_id, row_subject, row_canon, col_id, col_subject, col_canon, distance)
  
  df_long
}

# 生成
dist_long_P1 <- extract_dist_long(beta_sA1toC6_P1vsP4matrix, samA1toA6_P1vsP4, "P1")
dist_long_P4 <- extract_dist_long(beta_sA1toC6_P1vsP4matrix, samA1toA6_P1vsP4, "P4")

prep_plot_df <- function(df, quartile_label) {
  df %>%
    transmute(
      Quartile   = quartile_label,   # "P1" 或 "P4"
      subject    = col_subject,      # 每个 subject
      canon      = col_canon,        # 非 A1 的时间点
      distance   = distance
    )
}

# 1) 构造长表（不依赖 as.table 的 Var1/Var2），并解析 subject 与 canon
df_long <- expand.grid(
  row = rownames(dist_mat),
  col = colnames(dist_mat),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(bray = dist_mat[cbind(match(row, rownames(dist_mat)),
                               match(col, colnames(dist_mat)))]) %>%
  mutate(
    subject_row = str_replace(row, "_[^_]+$", ""),
    canon_row   = str_extract(row, "[^_]+$"),
    subject_col = str_replace(col, "_[^_]+$", ""),
    canon_col   = str_extract(col, "[^_]+$")
  )

# 2) 仅保留同一 canon 下的配对，去掉对角线
df_same_canon <- df_long %>%
  filter(canon_row == canon_col) %>%
  filter(row != col)

# 3) 分组信息准备（确保只有 subject 与 Quartile 两列）
grp <- samA1toA6_P1vsP4 %>%
  select(subject, Quartile)

# 4) 分别将 P1/P4 分组信息连接到 row 和 col 侧，避免列名冲突
df_annot <- df_same_canon %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    grp %>% dplyr::distinct(subject, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% dplyr::rename(Quartile_row = Quartile),
    by = c("subject_row" = "subject")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    grp %>% dplyr::distinct(subject, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% dplyr::rename(Quartile_col = Quartile),
    by = c("subject_col" = "subject")
  )

# 5) 提取 P1 vs P4 的跨组配对，并去重（无序对仅保留一个）
df_p1_p4 <- df_annot %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    (Quartile_row == "P1" & Quartile_col == "P4") |
    (Quartile_row == "P4" & Quartile_col == "P1")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pair_id = dplyr::if_else(row < col, paste(row, col, sep = "||"),
                             paste(col, row, sep = "||"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    canon = canon_row,  # 与 canon_col 一致
    subject_row, Quartile_row,
    subject_col, Quartile_col,
    bray
  )

# 6) 按 canon 汇总统计
summary_by_canon <- df_p1_p4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(canon) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pairs      = dplyr::n(),
    mean_bray    = mean(bray, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bray  = median(bray, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_bray      = sd(bray, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25          = stats::quantile(bray, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75          = stats::quantile(bray, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_meanbray_P1vsP4_bycanon <- ggplot(summary_by_canon, aes(x = canon, y = mean_bray, group = 1)) +

    title = "P1 vs P4 mean Bray distance by canon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

      p_val_adj = padj,
      baseMean  = baseMean,

    )

  res_tp
```

```{r}
# 用 base R 实现 parse_id（按最后一个下划线分割）-----
parse_id <- function(ids) {
  last_uscore_pos <- function(x) {
    m <- gregexpr("_", x, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(m) == 1 && m[1] == -1) return(NA_integer_)
    max(m)
  }
  pos <- vapply(ids, last_uscore_pos, integer(1))
  if (any(is.na(pos))) {
    bad <- ids[is.na(pos)]
    stop("部分ID缺少下划线分隔，示例: ", paste(utils::head(bad), collapse = ", "))
  }
  data.frame(
    id = ids,
    subject = substr(ids, 1, pos - 1),
    canon   = substr(ids, pos + 1, nchar(ids)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
library(dplyr)

extract_dist_long <- function(dist_mat, meta_df, group_value = c("P1","P4")) {
  group_value <- match.arg(group_value)
  
  subj_in_group <- meta_df %>%
    filter(Quartile == group_value) %>%
    pull(subject) %>%
    unique()
  
  rn <- rownames(dist_mat)
  cn <- colnames(dist_mat)
  rinfo <- parse_id(rn)
  cinfo <- parse_id(cn)
  
  # 行：该分组 subject 的 A1
  row_keep <- rinfo$subject %in% subj_in_group & rinfo$canon == "A1"
  # 列：该分组 subject 的非 A1
  col_keep <- cinfo$subject %in% subj_in_group & cinfo$canon != "A1"
  
  sub_mat <- dist_mat[row_keep, col_keep, drop = FALSE]
  rinfo_sub <- rinfo[row_keep, ]
  cinfo_sub <- cinfo[col_keep, ]
  
  if (nrow(sub_mat) == 0 || ncol(sub_mat) == 0) {
    return(dplyr::tibble(
      group = character(0),
      row_id = character(0), row_subject = character(0), row_canon = character(0),
      col_id = character(0), col_subject = character(0), col_canon = character(0),
      distance = numeric(0)
    ))
  }
  
  df_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(sub_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df_long) <- c("row_id", "col_id", "distance")
  
  df_long <- df_long %>%
    left_join(rinfo_sub %>% select(id, row_subject = subject, row_canon = canon),
              by = c("row_id" = "id")) %>%
    left_join(cinfo_sub %>% select(id, col_subject = subject, col_canon = canon),
              by = c("col_id" = "id")) %>%
    mutate(group = group_value) %>%
    select(group, row_id, row_subject, row_canon, col_id, col_subject, col_canon, distance)
  
  df_long
}

# 生成

  # 过滤 OTU_distance_s 的列，只保留此 subject 内，canon 为 A1 到 A4 的样本
  A_samples <- meta_distance %>%
    filter(subject == !!subject & canon %in% c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4")) %>%
    select(sample)
  
  if (nrow(A_samples) > 0) {
    OTU_distance_s_A <- OTU_distance_s[, colnames(OTU_distance_s) %in% A_samples$sample]
    
    # 计算 Bray 距离矩阵
    bray_dist <- vegdist(t(OTU_distance_s_A), method = "bray")
    
    # 将结果转换为矩阵
    bray_dist_matrix <- as.matrix(bray_dist)
    
    # 将结果保存到 subject_bray_pre
    for (i in 1:nrow(bray_dist_matrix)) {
      for (j in 1:ncol(bray_dist_matrix)) {
        subject_bray_pre[subject, subjects[i]] <- bray_dist_matrix[i, j]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

##恢复期斜率大小定义恢复好/坏
```{r}
##分析基线菌群对多样性恢复速率的影响
# 需要用到的基线与随访时间点
baseline_canons <- paste0("A", 1:4)               # A1~A4
post_canons     <- c("B6", paste0("C", 1:6))      # B6, C1~C6
post_order      <- factor(post_canons, levels = post_canons)  # 控制顺序

# 辅助函数：对单个 subject 生成结果数据框
make_subject_df <- function(df_subject) {
  subj_id <- unique(df_subject$subject)
  if (length(subj_id) != 1L) {
    stop("Input df_subject must contain exactly one subject.")
  }

  # 1) 基线均值（A1~A4）
  baseline_mean <- df_subject %>%
    filter(canon %in% baseline_canons) %>%
    summarise(baseline = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(baseline)

  # 若基线全缺失，mean(..., na.rm=TRUE) 返回 NaN；转为 NA 以便更直观
  if (is.nan(baseline_mean)) baseline_mean <- NA_real_

  # 2) 取出 post 时间点（B6, C1~C6），保持顺序，并允许缺失
  post_df <- df_subject %>%
    filter(canon %in% post_canons) %>%
    mutate(canon = factor(as.character(canon), levels = post_canons)) %>%
    arrange(canon) %>%
    select(canon, Value)

  # 如果某些 post 时间点缺失，补齐为 NA，确保 7 行
  post_df <- post_df %>%
    right_join(tibble(canon = factor(post_canons, levels = post_canons)), by = "canon") %>%
    arrange(canon)

  # 3) 组装结果数据框
  out <- tibble(
    baseline = rep(baseline_mean, length(post_canons)),
    post     = post_df$Value,
    diff     = post_df$Value - baseline_mean
  )

  # 设置行名：{subject}_{post}
  rn <- paste0(subj_id, "_", as.character(post_df$canon))
  # 将 tibble 转为 data.frame 以便设置 rownames
  out_df <- as.data.frame(out, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rownames(out_df) <- rn

  out_df
}

# 为每个 subject 生成一个数据框，并存入命名列表
subjects <- shannon_df %>% pull(subject) %>% unique() %>% sort()

library(purrr)
shannon_v_analysis <- subjects %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(function(sid) {
    df_subj <- shannon_df %>% filter(subject == sid)
    make_subject_df(df_subj)
  })

# post 到天数的映射
post_to_days <- c(
  B6 = 6, C1 = 7, C2 = 8, C3 = 10, C4 = 18, C5 = 28, C6 = 77
)

# 辅助函数：给单个 subject 的数据框（来自 shannon_v_analysis[[subj]]）计算 days
compute_days_for_subject <- function(df_subject) {
  # df_subject 预期包含列：baseline, post, diff
  # 行名格式：subject_post
  rn <- rownames(df_subject)
  # 提取 post 标签（B6, C1...C6）
  posts <- sub("^.*?_(B6|C[1-6])$", "\\1", rn)
  # 若行名不符合预期，稳健处理：从列里尝试恢复
  if (any(is.na(posts))) {
    # 尝试从 post 列恢复，如果有 canon 列，可改为 df_subject$canon
    # 此处按要求行名必须为 subject_post，因此若 NA，给出保护：
    stop("Row names must be 'subject_post' with post in {B6, C1..C6}.")
  }

  diffs <- df_subject$diff

  # 计算“忽略 0”的符号序列：-1, +1；0 维持 NA 用于跳过
  sgn_raw <- sign(diffs)
  sgn <- ifelse(sgn_raw == 0 | is.na(sgn_raw), NA, sgn_raw)

  # 找到按顺序的非零符号索引
  nz_idx <- which(!is.na(sgn))

  # 情况：全为 0 或全为 NA
  if (length(nz_idx) == 0) {
    days <- 0L
    return(days)
  }

  # 将相邻非零符号比较，统计变号次数，并定位第一次变号发生在哪个行索引
  # 变号发生在位置 nz_idx[j]（j>=2）且 sgn[nz_idx[j]] != sgn[nz_idx[j-1]]
  change_points <- integer(0)
  for (j in 2:length(nz_idx)) {
    i_prev <- nz_idx[j-1]
    i_curr <- nz_idx[j]
    if (!is.na(sgn[i_prev]) && !is.na(sgn[i_curr]) && sgn[i_prev] != sgn[i_curr]) {
      change_points <- c(change_points, i_curr)  # 记录发生变号的新符号所在行
    }
  }

  n_changes <- length(change_points)

  if (n_changes == 0) {
    # 全正或全负（可能夹着若干 0）
    days <- 0L
  } else if (n_changes == 1) {
    # 恰好一次变号：取第一次变号发生的行的 post -> days
    idx <- change_points[1]
    post_at_change <- posts[idx]
    if (!post_at_change %in% names(post_to_days)) {
      stop(paste0("Unknown post label: ", post_at_change))
    }
    days <- as.integer(post_to_days[[post_at_change]])
  } else {
    # 两次或以上变号
    days <- 1L
  }

  days
}

combined_data <- NULL

for (i in seq_along(shannon_v_analysis)) {
  # 提取当前数据框
  current_df <- shannon_v_analysis[[i]]
  
  # 将当前数据框添加到合并后的数据框中
  combined_data <- rbind(combined_data, current_df)
  
  # 如果不是最后一个数据框，在后面添加一个空行
  if (i < length(shannon_v_analysis)) {
    empty_row <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = ncol(current_df), nrow = 1))
    colnames(empty_row) <- colnames(current_df)
    combined_data <- rbind(combined_data, empty_row)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# 假设OTU和mrecover数据框已经加载
# 提取样本ID
samples <- colnames(OTU)

# Step 1: 将OTU数据框转换为长格式
OTU_long <- as.data.frame(t(OTU)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample = rownames(.)) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -sample, names_to = "species", values_to = "abundance")

# Step 2: 合并OTU_long和mrecover数据
mrecover <- as.data.frame(mrecover)
mrecover$sample <- rownames(mrecover)  # 将样本ID作为新列添加
merged_data <- merge(OTU_long, mrecover, by = "sample")

# Step 3: 过滤出我们关心的物种和特定分组
filtered_data <- merged_data %>%
  filter(species %in% c("s__Alistipes_shahii", "s__Bacteroides_pectinophilus") &
           v_group %in% c("recover", "non_recover", "repeat_recover"))

# Step 4: 过滤出特定的canon
filtered_data_A1_A4 <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(canon %in% c("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4"))

# Step 5: 计算平均相对丰度并除以100
average_abundance <- filtered_data_A1_A4 %>%
  group_by(species, v_group) %>%
  summarize(mean_abundance = mean(abundance) / 100, .groups = 'drop')

# Step 6: 排序数据以确保每个菌的柱子从左到右高度递减
average_abundance <- average_abundance %>%
  arrange(species, desc(mean_abundance))

# Step 7: 将v_group设置为一个有序因子，以保证绘图时的顺序
average_abundance$v_group <- factor(average_abundance$v_group,
                                     levels = unique(average_abundance$v_group[order(average_abundance$mean_abundance[average_abundance$species == unique(average_abundance$species[1])], decreasing = TRUE)]))

# Step 8: 绘制柱状图
ggplot(average_abundance, aes(x = species, y = mean_abundance, fill = v_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Average Relative Abundance") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("recover" = "#3480b8", 
                                "non_recover" = "#c82423", 
                                "repeat_recover" = "purple")) +  # 自定义填充颜色
  theme_minimal() +  # 使用minimal主题
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 删除主要网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # 删除次要网格线
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)  # 添加黑色边框
  )

  summarize(mean_abundance = mean(Relative_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Step 4: 绘制柱状图
ggplot(average_abundance, aes(x = Group, y = mean_abundance, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Average Relative Abundance") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("s__Alistipes_shahii" = "#3480b8", 
                                "s__Bacteroides_pectinophilus" = "#c82423")) +  # 自定义填充颜色
  theme_minimal() +  # 使用minimal主题
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # 删除主要网格线
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # 删除次要网格线
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)  # 添加黑色边框
  )
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

#P1vsP4

path <- read.csv("/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/qt/科研/课题/抗生素影响肠菌组装课题/ABX_nature/rawdata/代谢产物分析/pathway_cpm_unstratified.csv", header = T, sep = ',', row.names = 1)

path$X.1 <- NULL
path <- path[-c(1, 2), ]
path_P1vsP4 <- path[, colnames(path) %in% rownames(Sample_data_A1toA4[Sample_data_A1toA4$Quartile %in% c("P1", "P4"), ])]

rownames(path_P1vsP4) <- sub(".*: ", "", rownames(path_P1vsP4))

# 1. 创建分组信息，从 Sample_data_A1toA4 中提取  
group_info <- factor(Sample_data_A1toA4$Quartile, levels = c("P1", "P4"))  
Sample_data_A1toA4$Quartile <- factor(Sample_data_A1toA4$Quartile)

all(colnames(path_P1vsP4) %in% rownames(Sample_data_A1toA4))  # 应该返回 TRUE

# 1. 构建设计矩阵（P1 作为基线，比较 P4 vs P1）
group  <- factor(Sample_data_A1toA4$Quartile, levels = c("P1", "P4"))
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group)
colnames(design) <- c("P1", "P4")

# 2. 拟合线性模型
fit <- lmFit(path_P1vsP4, design)

# 3. 设定对比：P4 - P1
contrast.matrix <- makeContrasts(
  P4_vs_P1 = P4 - P1,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast.matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# 4. 提取全部通路的差异结果
res_all <- topTable(
  fit2,
  coef = "P4_vs_P1",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH"
)
res_all$Pathway <- rownames(res_all)

# 5. 筛选显著差异通路（可选）
res_sig <- subset(res_all, adj.P.Val < 0.05)
res_sig <- res_sig[order(res_sig$adj.P.Val), ]

## 1. 转为矩阵
mat <- as.matrix(path_P1vsP4)  # 行：pathway；列：样本
## 2. 计算每行标准差，去掉 sd = 0 的 pathway（否则 zscore 会出 NaN）
row_sd <- apply(mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
mat_nonconst <- mat[row_sd > 0, , drop = FALSE]
## 3. 对“行”做 z-score：对每个 pathway，在所有样本上中心化 & 标准化
mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat_nonconst), center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))

ann_col <- data.frame(
  Group = Sample_data_A1toA4$Quartile   # 或你的分组列
)
rownames(ann_col) <- rownames(Sample_data_A1toA4)  # 与列名一致

pheatmap(
  mat_z,
  scale = "none",            
  annotation_col = ann_col,      # 样本分组注释（可选）
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
)




path_P1vsP4 <- path_P1vsP4[, rownames(Sample_data_A1toA4)]

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(  
  countData = round(path_P1vsP4),  # 将丰度数据转换为整数值  
  colData = Sample_data_A1toA4$Quartile,  # 使用 group 信息

)

group_labels <- ifelse(rel_values == 0, "Alistipes_shahii-", "Alistipes_shahii+")

m88 <- m88[colnames(o88_rel), ]
# 添加分组信息
m88$group <- group_labels
m88$group <- gsub("\\+", "_plus", m88$group)
m88$group <- gsub("-", "_minus", m88$group)

# 转换为因子
m88$group <- factor(m88$group)

all(colnames(pathway_88) %in% rownames(m88))  # 应该返回 TRUE

  design = ~ group
)

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("group", "Alistipes_shahii_plus", "Alistipes_shahii_minus"))

sig_res <- subset(res_df, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
sig_res <- sig_res[order(sig_res$padj), ]  # 按显著性排序

# ---- 参数设置 ----
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
lfc_cutoff  <- 1

# ---- 添加显著性状态 ----
res_df$change <- "Not sig"
res_df$change[res_df$padj < padj_cutoff & res_df$log2FoldChange >  lfc_cutoff]  <- "Up"
res_df$change[res_df$padj < padj_cutoff & res_df$log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff] <- "Down"

# ---- 添加标签（仅显著者显示 pathway 名）----
res_df$label <- ifelse(res_df$padj < padj_cutoff & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff,
                       rownames(res_df), "")

# ---- 可选：只标注前 10 个显著 pathway ----
top_labels <- head(subset(res_df, label != ""), 10)

# ---- 绘制火山图 ----
ggplot(
  res_df,
  aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 3.5, aes(color = change)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Down" = "#010290", "Not sig" = "grey", "Up" = "#e10000")) +
  # 可选 shape 手动映射（如果需要）
  # scale_shape_manual(values = c(19, 15, 17)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cutoff, lfc_cutoff), lty = 2, col = "black", lwd = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cutoff), lty = 2, col = "black", lwd = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Pathway Differential Analysis (DESeq2)",
    x = "log₂(Fold Change)",
    y = "-log₁₀(Adjusted P-value)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  # ---- 添加文字标签 ----
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = label),
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    point.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"),
    segment.color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE,
    max.overlaps = 2000,
    fontface = "italic"
  )
```

```{r}
BiocManager::install("KEGGREST")
library(KEGGREST)

## 1) 获取 KO ↔ pathway 的所有链接
ko_path <- keggLink("pathway", "ko")
# 这是一个 named character 向量：
# names(ko_path) = "ko:K00001", 值 = "path:map00010" / "path:hsa00010" 等
## 2) 整理成 data.frame：ko, pathway
ko2path <- tibble(
  ko      = names(ko_path),
  pathway = unname(ko_path)
) |>
  mutate(
    ko      = str_remove(ko,      "^ko:"),
    pathway = str_remove(pathway, "^path:")
  )
# 如果你只关心参考路径（map0xxxxx），可以再过滤：
ko2map_ref <- ko2path |>
  filter(str_detect(pathway, "^map\\d{5}$"))
# 如果需要物种特异路径（hsaxxxxx, mmuxxxxx 等），可以按前缀筛选，比如人类：
ko2path_hsa <- ko2path |>
  filter(str_detect(pathway, "^hsa\\d{5}$"))

ko_rn <- keggLink("reaction", "ko")
ko2rxn <- tibble(
  ko      = names(ko_rn),
  reaction = unname(ko_rn)
) |>
  mutate(
    ko       = str_remove(ko, "^ko:"),
    reaction = str_remove(reaction, "^rn:")
  )

rn_ec <- keggLink("enzyme", "reaction")
rxn2ec <- tibble(
  reaction = names(rn_ec),
  ec       = unname(rn_ec)
) |>
  mutate(
    reaction = str_remove(reaction, "^rn:"),
    ec       = str_remove(ec,       "^ec:")
  )

## 合并成 KO → reaction → EC
ko2rxn2ec <- ko2rxn |>
  inner_join(rxn2ec, by = "reaction")

## 1) 拿所有 pathway 的 ID + name
pw_info <- keggList("pathway")
# pw_info 是一个 named character 向量：
#   names = "path:map00010", 值 = "Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis" 等

pw_anno <- tibble(
  pathway_full = names(pw_info),
  path_name    = unname(pw_info)
) |>
  mutate(
    pathway = str_remove(pathway_full, "^path:")
  ) |>
  select(pathway, path_name)

## 2) 合并到你已有的 ko2map_ref / ko2path 等
ko2map_ref_anno <- ko2map_ref |>
  left_join(pw_anno, by = "pathway")

## 1) 拿所有 reaction 的 ID + 名称
rn_info <- keggList("reaction")
# names = "rn:R00001", 值 = "Oxidation of ..." 等

rn_anno <- tibble(
  rn_full = names(rn_info),
  rn_name = unname(rn_info)
) |>
  mutate(
    reaction = str_remove(rn_full, "^rn:")
  ) |>
  select(reaction, rn_name)

## 2) 合并到 ko2rxn 或 ko2rxn2ec
ko2rxn_anno <- ko2rxn |>
  left_join(rn_anno, by = "reaction")

ko2rxn2ec_anno <- ko2rxn2ec |>
  left_join(rn_anno, by = "reaction")

##合并到pathway
## 1) 确保 KO 名字一致：行名 KXXXXX，对应 ko2map_ref$ko
ko_df <- as.data.frame(ko)
ko_df$ko <- rownames(ko_df)
## 2) 只保留在映射表中的 KO（可选，但推荐）
ko_df2 <- ko_df %>%
  filter(ko %in% ko2map_ref$ko)

## 3) 宽表 -> 长表：每一行是 (ko, sample, abundance)
ko_long <- ko_df2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -ko,
    names_to  = "sample",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )

## 4) 合并 KO → pathway 映射
# 如果你只想用参考路径 map0xxxxx，直接用 ko2map_ref；
# 若想用物种特异路径，则换成相应的 ko2path_xxx。
ko_long_path <- ko_long %>%
  inner_join(ko2map_ref, by = "ko")
# 现在每行：ko, sample, abundance, pathway

## 5) 按 pathway + sample 聚合求和
path_abund <- ko_long_path %>%
  group_by(pathway, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

## 6) 再转回矩阵形式：行 = pathway，列 = sample
path_mat <- path_abund %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = sample,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )

path_mat <- as.data.frame(path_mat)
rownames(path_mat) <- path_mat$pathway
path_mat$pathway <- NULL

# KO -> module
ko_mod <- keggLink("module", "ko")
# ko_mod_raw: names = "ko:K00001", values = "md:M00001" 等

ko2mod <- enframe(ko_mod, name = "ko", value = "module") %>%
  mutate(
    ko     = str_remove(ko,     "^ko:"),
    module = str_remove(module, "^md:")
  ) %>%
  distinct()

## 3. 按 module 和 sample 求和，得到 module 丰度
mod_long <- ko_mod_long %>%
  group_by(module, sample) %>%

run_deseq <- function(expr_mat, meta_df, group_col, 
                      ctrl_level, case_level) {
  ## 1. 按 sample 对齐
  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_mat), meta_df$sample)
  expr_use <- expr_mat[ , common_samples, drop = FALSE]

  meta_use <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(sample %in% common_samples) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(meta_use) <- meta_use$sample
  meta_use$sample <- NULL

  ## 2. 去掉分组为 NA 或不在这两个水平里的样本
  meta_use <- meta_use[!is.na(meta_use[[group_col]]), , drop = FALSE]
  meta_use <- meta_use[meta_use[[group_col]] %in% c(ctrl_level, case_level), , drop = FALSE]

  ## 同步表达矩阵
  expr_use <- expr_use[ , rownames(meta_use), drop = FALSE]
  stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_use) == rownames(meta_use)))

  ## 3. 转整数
  expr_int <- round(as.matrix(expr_use), 0)

  ## 4. 设定分组因子
  meta_use[[group_col]] <- factor(meta_use[[group_col]],
                                  levels = c(ctrl_level, case_level))

  ## 5. 构建 DESeqDataSet
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = expr_int,
    colData   = meta_use,
    design    = as.formula(paste0("~ ", group_col))
  )

  ## 6. 过滤和差异分析
  dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 0, ]
  dds <- DESeq(dds)

  res <- results(
    dds,
    contrast = c(group_col, case_level, ctrl_level),
    alpha = 0.05
  )

  res_df <- res %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("feature")

  list(
    dds       = dds,
    res_table = res_df
  )
}

  meta_df     = meta3,
  group_col   = "group",
  ctrl_level  = "non_recover",
  case_level  = "recover"
)
```

```{r}
)


run_lefse_for_modules <- function(mod_ids, 
                                  otu_mat = mod_sub2,
                                  tax_tab = mod_tax,
                                  meta = meta2_2,
                                  group_col = "group",
                                  alpha = 0.05,
                                  taxa_level = "pathway") {
  # 先在 otu / tax 里只保留这些 Module
  keep_ids <- intersect(mod_ids, rownames(otu_mat))
  if (length(keep_ids) == 0) {
    warning("No modules from the provided list found in otu_mat.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  otu_use <- otu_mat[keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  tax_use <- tax_tab[keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  # 构造 microtable
  mt <- microtable$new(sample_table = meta,
                       otu_table     = otu_use,
                       tax_table     = tax_use)
  mt$tidy_dataset()

  # LEfSe 分析
  td <- trans_diff$new(
    dataset       = mt,
    method        = "lefse",
    group         = group_col,
    alpha         = alpha,
    lefse_subgroup = NULL,
    taxa_level    = taxa_level
  )

  return(td)
}

## 4) Amino acid metabolism

run_lefse_for_modules_xeno <- function(mod_ids,
                                       otu_mat = mod_sub2,
                                       tax_tab = mod_tax,
                                       meta = meta2_2,
                                       group_col = "group",
                                       alpha = 0.05,
                                       taxa_level = "pathway") {
  keep_ids <- intersect(mod_ids, rownames(otu_mat))
  if (length(keep_ids) == 0) {
    warning("No modules from the provided list found in otu_mat.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  otu_use <- otu_mat[keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  tax_use <- tax_tab[keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  mt <- microtable$new(sample_table = meta,
                       otu_table     = otu_use,
                       tax_table     = tax_use)
  mt$tidy_dataset()

  td <- trans_diff$new(
    dataset        = mt,
    method         = "lefse",
    group          = group_col,
    alpha          = alpha,
    lefse_subgroup = NULL,
    taxa_level     = taxa_level,
    p_adjust_method = "none"    # 关键：取消多重校正
  )

  return(td)
}

#用 DESeq2 分析 KO，筛选显著差异 KO
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
# 1) 样本对齐
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(ko_df), rownames(meta2))
ko_df2  <- ko_df[, common_samples, drop = FALSE]

# 确保 group 为 factor，且设定参考水平，如果需要

# 2) 构建 DESeqDataSet
dds_ko <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(ko_df2),
  colData   = meta2_2,
  design    = ~ group
)

# 3) 跑 DESeq2
dds_ko <- DESeq(dds_ko)

# 4) 取结果：对比 P4 vs P1（根据你的分组名改）
res_ko <- results(dds_ko, contrast = c("group", "P4", "P1"))

# 5) 整理结果为 data.frame，带上 KO 编号
res_ko_df <- as.data.frame(res_ko) %>%
  mutate(
    ko = rownames(res_ko),
    padj = ifelse(is.na(padj), 1, padj)  # NA padj 处理成 1，方便筛选
  )

# 6) 根据阈值筛选显著差异 KO
# 阈值可以按你习惯修改，比如 padj < 0.05 且 |log2FC| > 1
sig_ko_df <- res_ko_df %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05, abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
sig_ko_vec <- sig_ko_df$ko
sig_ko2mod <- ko2mod %>%
  filter(ko %in% sig_ko_vec)

# 把差异结果信息合并进来
sig_ko_annot <- sig_ko_df %>%
  inner_join(sig_ko2mod, by = "ko")

# 为每个模块编号标上所属大类
module2cat <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(module = mod_carbo,     category = "Carbohydrate metabolism"),
  data.frame(module = mod_cofactor,  category = "Metabolism of cofactors and vitamins"),
  data.frame(module = mod_lipid,     category = "Lipid metabolism"),
  data.frame(module = mod_aa,        category = "Amino acid metabolism"),
  data.frame(module = mod_glycan,    category = "Glycan metabolism"),
  data.frame(module = mod_terp_poly, category = "Terpenoids & polyketides"),
  data.frame(module = mod_xeno,      category = "Xenobiotics degradation")
)

sig_ko_annot2 <- sig_ko_annot %>%
  left_join(module2cat, by = "module")
sig_ko_annot2 <- sig_ko_annot2[!is.na(sig_ko_annot2$category), ]


##取各个category的KO分组绘制热图
ko_sig_mat <- ko_df2[intersect(sig_ko_vec, rownames(ko_df2)), , drop = FALSE]

# log 变换 + 行标准化
log_ko_sig <- log10(ko_sig_mat + 1)

scale_rows <- function(x) t(scale(t(x)))
log_ko_sig_z <- scale_rows(log_ko_sig)

sig_ko_carbo <- sig_ko_annot2 %>%
  filter(category == "Carbohydrate metabolism") %>%
  pull(ko) %>% unique()

sig_ko_cofactor <- sig_ko_annot2 %>%
  filter(category == "Metabolism of cofactors and vitamins") %>%
  pull(ko) %>% unique()



ko_carbo_mat <- log_ko_sig_z[intersect(sig_ko_carbo, rownames(log_ko_sig_z)), , drop = FALSE]
ko_cofactor_mat <- log_ko_sig_z[intersect(sig_ko_cofactor, rownames(log_ko_sig_z)), , drop = FALSE]


# 列注释：group
ann_col <- data.frame(
  group = factor(meta2_2$group, levels = c("P1", "P4"))
)
rownames(ann_col) <- rownames(meta2_2)


ann_colors <- list(
  group = c(P1 = "#3480b8", P4 = "#c82423")
)



# 按 group 把样本顺序设为：P4 在前，P1 在后
samples_P4 <- rownames(meta2_2)[meta2_2$group == "P4"]
samples_P1 <- rownames(meta2_2)[meta2_2$group == "P1"]
new_order  <- c(samples_P4, samples_P1)

# 只保留实际在矩阵中的列
new_order  <- intersect(new_order, colnames(log_ko_sig_z))

# 重新排序整体矩阵
log_ko_sig_z2 <- log_ko_sig_z[, new_order, drop = FALSE]

# 重新生成两个大类的子矩阵（列顺序已是 P4 在前，P1 在后）
ko_carbo_mat    <- log_ko_sig_z2[intersect(sig_ko_carbo, rownames(log_ko_sig_z2)), , drop = FALSE]
ko_cofactor_mat <- log_ko_sig_z2[intersect(sig_ko_cofactor, rownames(log_ko_sig_z2)), , drop = FALSE]

# 同时给列注释也按新顺序排一下（如果还没排）

ann_col <- data.frame(

)
rownames(ann_col) <- rownames(meta2_2_sub)

# Carbohydrate metabolism 的 KO 热图


row_clu    <- hclust(dist(ko_carbo_mat))
k          <- 6
row_groups <- cutree(row_clu, k = k)

ht_carbo <- Heatmap(
  ko_carbo_mat,
  name = "z-score",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,          # 让 Heatmap 自己做层次聚类
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(df = ann_col,
                                     col = ann_colors),

    c(-2, 0, 2),
    c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
  ),
  row_split = row_groups        # 用向量分块
)

draw(ht_carbo)



# Cofactor 的 KO 热图
# 想要的簇数（和 carbo 保持一致）
k <- 6

ht_cofactor <- Heatmap(
  ko_cofactor_mat,
  name = "z-score",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,          # Heatmap 自己做行聚类
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(df = ann_col,
                                     col = ann_colors),
  col = colorRamp2(
    c(-2, 0, 2),
    c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
  ),
  row_split = k                 # 按行聚类树自动切成 k 块
)

draw(ht_cofactor)
```

```{r}
colnames(design)

) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ko")

  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%

  # 3. 合并 Reaction / EC 注释（含 rn_name）
  left_join(ko2rxn2ec_anno,  by = "ko")

# 假定 ko_A1toA4_P1vsP4 是“样本 x KO”，DESeq2 需要“KO x 样本”

count_mat <- round(count_mat)
# 分组信息：P1 / P4

)
# 可选：过滤低表达 KO（例如行和至少 >= 10）
dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10, ]

# 运行 DESeq2 主流程
dds <- DESeq(dds)



res_deseq <- results(

  contrast = c("Quartile", "P4", "P1"),  # P4 vs P1

)

res_deseq <- as.data.frame(res_deseq)

      str_detect(ec, "\\b3\\.5\\.1\\.19\\b") |

      str_detect(ec, "\\b3\\.7\\.1\\.3\\b")    |
      str_detect(ec, "\\b1\\.13\\.11\\.6\\b")  |

      str_detect(ec, "\\b2\\.7\\.7\\.18\\b")   |
      str_detect(ec, "\\b6\\.3\\.5\\.1\\b")    |

    kegg_reaction = case_when(

      str_detect(rn_name, "Quinolinate") |

      # ---------- 补救途径（Salvage） ----------

      str_detect(rn_name, "nicotinamide ribonucleotide phosphohydrolase") |

      str_detect(rn_name, "ATP:nicotinamide-nucleotide adenylyltransferase") |

      str_detect(rn_name, "nicotinate D-ribonucleoside:orthophosphate ribosyltransferase") |

      # ---------- 其余核苷/核苷酸代谢 ----------

    # 2) 显著性标签（可用于火山图等），用 padj 与 log2FoldChange
    sig = case_when(

    )
  )
```

```{r}
library(argparse)
library(DESeq2)
library(data.table)
library(BiocParallel)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(piano)

# Set arguments directly in the script
args <- list(
    input = "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/predbmc/genefamilies_ex.tsv",
    metadata = "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/predbmc/metadata_ex.tsv",
    output = "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/predbmc/output_uniref_ex.tsv",
    reference = "B",
    gene_metabolite = "/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/predbmc/interaction_ex.tsv",
    pvalue = 0.05,
    core = 4
)

# Assigning arguments to variables
input_data <- args$input
input_metadata <- args$metadata
output <- args$output
ref <- args$reference
cores <- args$core
gml <- args$gene_metabolite
pvalue <- args$pvalue

# DESeq2 #
## Loading DESeq2's input file (genefamily & metadata) ##
abundance_table <- data.frame(fread(input_data), row.names=1)
meta_table <- read.delim(input_metadata, sep = '\t', row.names = 1)

## Metadata processing ##
meta_table <- meta_table[1]
meta_table <- arrange(meta_table, eval(parse(text=colnames(meta_table)[1])))
abundance_table <- abundance_table[, rownames(meta_table)]


## Excluding gene families with zero of 60% or more for all samples ##
abundance_table <- abundance_table[rowSums(abundance_table) != 0, ]
abundance_table <- abundance_table[rowMeans(abundance_table == 0) < 0.7, ]

## Pick reference ##
meta_table[[1]] <- factor(meta_table[[1]])
meta_table[[1]] <- relevel(meta_table[[1]], ref)
colnames(meta_table)[1] <- "feature"

## Create DESeq2 data set ##
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = abundance_table,
                                 colData = meta_table,
                                 design = ~ 1 + feature)

## Run DESeq2 ##
## Use SnowParam on Windows ##
if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
    BPPARAM <- SnowParam(cores)
} else {
    BPPARAM <- MulticoreParam(cores)
}

dds_res <- DESeq(dds, sfType = "poscounts", parallel = TRUE, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
res <- results(dds_res, alpha = pvalue, name = resultsNames(dds_res)[2], parallel = TRUE, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
res <- as.data.frame(res)

# Reporter analysis #
## Loading Reporter analysis's input file (p-value & fold_change) ##
signres <- subset(res, pvalue > 0 & pvalue < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
signres_pv <- signres['pvalue']
signres_fc <- signres['log2FoldChange']

## Loading the gene-metabolite information file ##
gene_metabolite <- fread(gml)
gene_metabolite <- loadGSC(gene_metabolite)

## Run Reporter analysis ##
gsa_rep <- runGSA(signres_pv,
                  signres_fc,
                  gsc=gene_metabolite,
                  geneSetStat = "reporter",
                  signifMethod = "nullDist", nPerm = 1000,
                  gsSizeLim = c(1, Inf),
                  adjMethod = "BH")

# Save predicted metabolite's statistics #
GSAsummaryTable(gsa_rep, save = TRUE, output)

gsa_table <- read.csv(output, sep = '\t')
## Filtering ##
gsa_up <- gsa_table %>% filter(p..mix.dir.up. < p..mix.dir.dn.)
gsa_up_extracted <- gsa_up[c('Name', 'Stat..mix.dir.up.', 'p..mix.dir.up.', 'p.adj..mix.dir.up.')]
colnames(gsa_up_extracted) <- c('cpd', 'stat', 'pvalue','adj-pvalue')

gsa_down <- gsa_table %>% filter(p..mix.dir.up. > p..mix.dir.up.)
gsa_down_extracted <- gsa_down[c('Name', 'Stat..dist.dir.dn.', 'p..mix.dir.dn.','p.adj..mix.dir.dn.')]
colnames(gsa_down_extracted) <- c('cpd', 'stat', 'pvalue','adj-pvalue')

metabolite_stat <- rbind(gsa_up_extracted, gsa_down_extracted)
metabolite_name <- read.delim("/Users/qiaotong2023/Desktop/predbmc/kegg_cpd_name_v2021-11-24.tsv", sep = '\t')
```

```{r}
# 1. Load Data
data <- read.csv(input_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Define Significance based on P-value (not padj)
p_threshold <- 0.05
# You can also add a log2FC threshold if desired, but user focused on p-value.
# Let's set a minimal log2FC for classification but user emphasized p-value.
# Usually |log2FC| > 0 or > 1. Let's use |log2FC| > 0 for now as user just said "p threshold".
# Or standard is often p < 0.05.

data$Significance <- "NS"
data$Significance[data$pvalue < p_threshold & data$log2FoldChange > 0] <- "Up (AN)"
data$Significance[data$pvalue < p_threshold & data$log2FoldChange < 0] <- "Down (AS)"

# 3. Label Specific Bacteria
target_bacteria <- c("s__Bifidobacterium_pseudolongum", "s__Lactobacillus_intestinalis")
data$Label <- NA
data$Label[data$Species %in% target_bacteria] <- data$Species[data$Species %in% target_bacteria]

# Ensure targets are found
print("Target bacteria check:")
print(data[data$Species %in% target_bacteria, c("Species", "log2FoldChange", "pvalue", "Significance")])

# 4. Plot
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(pvalue), color = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up (AN)" = "red", "Down (AS)" = "blue", "NS" = "grey")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Label), 
                  box.padding = 0.5, 
                  point.padding = 0.5,
                  max.overlaps = Inf,
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  color = "black", # Label color
                  bg.color = "white", # Background shadow for text readability
                  bg.r = 0.15,
                  size = 4,
                  force = 10) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(p_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot (DESeq2, P-value < 0.05)",
       x = "log2 Fold Change (AN/AS)",
       y = "-log10(P-value)") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
